visual_elements.description: Feed-forward neural-network schematic, 3 rows (top/middle/bottom) x 5 columns of neuron circles inside the beige panel. Col 1: three gray circles, each split by a vertical line into 'Σ' (left) and 'S' (right); each is followed by three small hollow circles 'o o o'; four magenta dots stacked vertically at the far left (outside/edge of panel) feed thin gray lines into these three neurons. Col 2: three light-blue Σ|S neurons, each labeled 'O_i' (red italic) at its upper right. Col 3: three light-green Σ|S neurons labeled 'O_j'. Col 4: three light-orange Σ|S neurons labeled 'O_k'. Col 5: three gray Σ|S neurons, each preceded by two small hollow circles 'o o', each followed by a short black arrow to a black output box. Thin red lines fully mesh col2→col3, col3→col4, and col2→col4 (skip connections). Above the columns, red italic 'Net_i', 'Net_j', 'Net_k' each have a small red arrow pointing down-right onto the top neuron of cols 2/3/4. Blue italic weight labels sit on the lines: 'w_ji' (between cols 2-3, rows 1 and 2), 'w_kj' (between cols 3-4, row 1), 'w_ki' (row 1 area and a second instance rotated ~90° on the col2→col4 skip line, row 2).

Two magenta callout boxes with thin magenta borders and bold black two-line text: left box 'Input Samples' (with a small left-pointing arrow on its left edge), right box 'Sample Label'. A horizontal magenta dashed line runs from the Input Samples box across almost the full slide width to the Sample Label box.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a white slide; draw a thin dark-red (#990000) rectangle outline inset ~2% from all edges; add a solid black bar (~3% height) across the very bottom. 2. Add title text box, top center: 'Neural Network Model', Arial bold 36pt, #CC0000. 3. Top-left: magenta (#FF99FF) rectangle, thin #CC66CC border, bold black 11pt text on two lines: 'Input' / 'Samples'; add a small left-pointing triangle arrow on its left edge. Top-right: identical magenta box with 'Sample' / 'Label'. Connect the two boxes with a horizontal magenta dashed line at y≈25%. 4. Draw the main panel: rounded rectangle, fill #D6C6B6, from x≈6% to x≈82%, y≈29% to y≈77%. 5. Place 15 neuron circles (diameter ≈4% of slide width) in 3 rows x 5 columns at x≈15%, 26%, 44%, 61%, 72%: columns 1 and 5 filled #CCCCCC, column 2 #99CCFF, column 3 #99FF66, column 4 #FFCC66; each circle gets a vertical black divider line with 'Σ' on the left half and 'S' on the right half (black, ~10pt). 6. Add three small hollow circles ('o o o') just right of each column-1 neuron and two ('o o') just left of each column-5 neuron. 7. Far left, outside/at panel edge: four small magenta (#CC00CC) dots stacked vertically; draw thin gray lines from them fanning into the three column-1 neurons. 8. Draw thin red (#CC0000) connector lines fully meshing column 2→3, 3→4, and 2→4 (skip). 9. Add red italic labels with subscripts: 'Net_i', 'Net_j', 'Net_k' above columns 2/3/4, each with a small red arrow to the top neuron; 'O_i' at upper-right of each blue neuron, 'O_j' at each green, 'O_k' at each orange. 10. Add blue italic weight labels: 'w_ji' twice between columns 2-3 (rows 1-2), 'w_kj' between columns 3-4 (row 1), 'w_ki' once near row 1 and once rotated 90° on the 2→4 skip line (row 2). 11. From each column-5 neuron draw a short black arrow to a black rectangle with white 10pt text: 'Output 1' (row 1), 'Output 2' (row 2), 'Output m' (row 3). 12. Right of the panel: tall dark-red (#990000) rectangle; inside, add 'Error' three times in bold red (#FF0000) 14pt, each rotated 270° (reading bottom-to-top), aligned with the three rows. 13. Far right: three #99FF33 rectangles with black 11pt text 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m', row-aligned. 14. Bottom: three block arrows pointing up into the panel — blue (#3366CC) with white 'i', green (#33CC33) with white 'j', orange (#FF9933) with white 'k' — and beneath them three two-line boxes: #99CCFF box 'Previous Layer' / 'Layer (i)'; #99FF66 box 'Current Layer' / '(You are here)'; #FFCC66 box 'Next Layer' / 'Layer (K)', all black ~10pt text.
